questions.question: Express.js middleware là gì và hoạt động thế nào?

options.B: Middleware là function với (req, res, next) — xử lý request trước khi đến route handler; gọi next() để pass sang middleware tiếp theo hoặc res.send() để kết thúc
options.C: Middleware chỉ dùng cho authentication

questions.explanation: Middleware pipeline: request → middleware1 → middleware2 → route handler → response. Function signature: (req, res, next) => { /* logic */ next(); }. Types: Application-level (app.use()), Router-level (router.use()), Error-handling (4 args: err, req, res, next), Built-in (express.json(), express.static()), Third-party (morgan, cors, helmet). Order matters: middleware được execute theo thứ tự khai báo. next('route') skip remaining route middleware.

questions.question: Express Router là gì và tại sao nên dùng?

options.A: Router chỉ là alias của app
options.B: express.Router() tạo mini-app với routes riêng — cho phép modularize routes theo feature, mount với app.use('/api/users', userRouter)
options.C: Router không hỗ trợ middleware

questions.explanation: const router = express.Router(); router.get('/', getUsers); router.post('/', createUser); router.put('/:id', updateUser); router.delete('/:id', deleteUser). Mount: app.use('/api/users', router). Benefits: (1) Code organization theo feature. (2) Middleware scoped to router: router.use(authMiddleware). (3) Route prefix management. (4) Reusable. Pattern: routes/ folder với userRoutes.js, productRoutes.js, authRoutes.js — import và mount trong app.js.

questions.question: req.params, req.query, req.body khác nhau thế nào?

options.B: params: URL path variables (:id); query: URL query string (?key=value); body: request body (POST/PUT data)
options.C: query chỉ dùng với GET, body chỉ với POST

questions.explanation: req.params: /users/:id → GET /users/123 → req.params.id = '123'. Là string, convert với Number() hoặc parseInt(). req.query: GET /users?page=2&limit=10 → req.query = { page: '2', limit: '10' }. req.body: POST /users với JSON body → req.body = { name: 'John' } (cần express.json() middleware). req.headers: HTTP headers (Authorization, Content-Type). req.cookies: với cookie-parser middleware.

questions.question: Express error handling middleware khác gì với regular middleware?

options.B: Error middleware có 4 parameters (err, req, res, next) thay vì 3; phải khai báo sau tất cả routes; được gọi khi next(err) hoặc throw trong async handler
options.C: Error middleware không nhận next
options.D: Express tự handle errors, không cần error middleware

questions.explanation: Error middleware: app.use((err, req, res, next) => { console.error(err.stack); res.status(err.status || 500).json({ error: err.message }); }). Trigger: next(new Error('something went wrong')) hoặc throw (cần express-async-errors hoặc async wrapper). Custom error class: class AppError extends Error { constructor(message, status) { super(message); this.status = status; } }. Phải khai báo sau tất cả routes và middleware khác. Multiple error handlers có thể chain.

questions.question: CORS trong Express — tại sao cần và cách setup?

options.B: CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) cho phép browser requests từ different origins; dùng cors npm package với whitelist origins
options.C: CORS không cần thiết nếu API và frontend cùng server

questions.explanation: CORS: browser block requests đến different origin (domain, port, protocol) theo Same-Origin Policy. Backend phải opt-in bằng response headers. cors package: app.use(cors({ origin: ['https://app.com', 'http://localhost:3000'], methods: ['GET','POST','PUT','DELETE'], credentials: true })); OPTIONS preflight: cors tự handle. credentials: true cần khi send cookies/auth headers. production: whitelist specific origins, không dùng origin: '*' với credentials. Custom: res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', allowedOrigin).

questions.question: Express request/response lifecycle flow như thế nào?

options.B: Request → app-level middleware → router-level middleware → route-specific middleware → handler → error middleware → response
options.C: Response phải gửi trong route handler, không thể trong middleware

questions.explanation: Full flow: (1) Incoming request. (2) app.use() middleware (body-parser, cors, helmet, morgan, session). (3) Router matching. (4) Router-level middleware. (5) Route-specific middleware (authMiddleware, validateBody). (6) Route handler. (7) Response sent (res.json(), res.send(), res.redirect()). Error path: any middleware/handler gọi next(err) → skip đến error handling middleware. Key: chỉ 1 trong middleware/handler gửi response — nếu không gọi next(), request bị 'hung'. res.headersSent: check nếu response đã được gửi.

questions.question: Express với async/await — cách handle errors đúng cách?

options.B: Wrap async handlers với try/catch và gọi next(err), hoặc dùng express-async-errors package để auto-catch; hoặc custom asyncHandler wrapper
options.C: Không thể dùng async/await trong Express
options.D: Unhandled promise rejections sẽ gọi error middleware tự động

questions.explanation: Problem: Express không tự catch unhandled Promise rejections trước Express 5. Solution 1 - Manual: router.get('/:id', async (req, res, next) => { try { const user = await getUserById(req.params.id); res.json(user); } catch (err) { next(err); } }). Solution 2 - Wrapper: const asyncHandler = fn => (req, res, next) => Promise.resolve(fn(req, res, next)).catch(next). Dùng: router.get('/:id', asyncHandler(async (req, res) => { const user = await getUserById(req.params.id); res.json(user); })). Solution 3: express-async-errors package (monkey-patch Express). Express 5 (beta): tự wrap routes với Promise.catch.

questions.question: Express authentication với JWT — architecture đúng cách?

options.A: Lưu JWT trong localStorage phía server
options.B: Issue JWT khi login, verify trong auth middleware, store trong HttpOnly cookie hoặc Authorization header; implement refresh token rotation
options.C: JWT và session cookies là giống nhau

questions.explanation: JWT auth flow: POST /auth/login → verify credentials → sign JWT: jwt.sign({ userId: user.id, role: user.role }, SECRET, { expiresIn: '15m' }). Response: HttpOnly cookie hoặc { accessToken }. Middleware: const authMiddleware = (req, res, next) => { const token = req.cookies.token || req.headers.authorization?.split(' ')[1]; try { req.user = jwt.verify(token, SECRET); next(); } catch { res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }); } }. Refresh token: long-lived (7 days), store in DB, HttpOnly cookie. Rotate on use. Revocation: blacklist in Redis.

questions.question: Rate limiting trong Express — tại sao cần và implement thế nào?

options.A: Rate limiting chỉ cần ở infrastructure level
options.B: express-rate-limit middleware giới hạn requests per window per IP — ngăn brute force, DDoS, API abuse; Redis store cho distributed systems
options.C: Rate limiting giảm performance không cần thiết

questions.explanation: Rate limiting: const limiter = rateLimit({ windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000, max: 100, message: { error: 'Too many requests' }, standardHeaders: true, legacyHeaders: false }); app.use('/api', limiter). Strict limit cho auth: const authLimiter = rateLimit({ windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000, max: 5 }); router.post('/login', authLimiter, loginHandler). Redis store (distributed): new RedisStore({ client: redisClient }) — share limits across multiple Node instances. Bypass: skip cho internal IPs, admin tokens. Response headers: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining.

questions.question: Express validation với Joi, Zod hoặc express-validator?

options.A: Validation không cần thiết nếu dùng TypeScript
options.B: Validate input trong middleware trước route handler — reject invalid data sớm; Zod, Joi, hoặc express-validator đều phổ biến
options.C: Chỉ validate trên frontend là đủ

questions.explanation: Zod (TypeScript-first): const schema = z.object({ name: z.string().min(1).max(100), email: z.string().email(), age: z.number().int().min(18) }). Middleware: const validate = (schema) => (req, res, next) => { const result = schema.safeParse(req.body); if (!result.success) return res.status(400).json({ errors: result.error.errors }); req.body = result.data; next(); }. Dùng: router.post('/users', validate(createUserSchema), createUserHandler). Joi: Joi.object({...}).validate(). express-validator: check('email').isEmail(), validationResult(req). Best: Zod cho TypeScript projects.

questions.question: Express với databases — connection pooling và ORM patterns?

options.A: Tạo database connection mới mỗi request
options.B: Dùng connection pool (pg.Pool, mysql2 pool); Prisma/Sequelize/TypeORM làm ORM; singleton pattern cho pool; graceful shutdown đóng connections
options.C: Express không hỗ trợ databases
options.D: ORM làm chậm ứng dụng đáng kể

questions.explanation: Connection pool: const pool = new Pool({ host: DB_HOST, max: 20, idleTimeoutMillis: 30000, connectionTimeoutMillis: 2000 }). Singleton: let poolInstance; function getPool() { if (!poolInstance) poolInstance = new Pool(config); return poolInstance; }. Prisma: export const prisma = global.__prisma || new PrismaClient(); if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') global.__prisma = prisma. Transaction: await prisma.$transaction([...]). Graceful shutdown: process.on('SIGTERM', async () => { await prisma.$disconnect(); server.close(() => process.exit(0)); }).

questions.question: Express security best practices — helmet, sanitization, HTTPS?

options.B: helmet() sets security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options); sanitize inputs; parameterized queries tránh SQL injection; rate limiting; CORS whitelist
options.C: Express tự handle security
options.D: Security chỉ cần ở firewall level

questions.explanation: Security checklist: (1) helmet(): app.use(helmet()) — set 11 security headers. CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, HSTS. (2) SQL Injection: parameterized queries (db.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1', [userId])) — KHÔNG string concatenation. (3) XSS: express-validator sanitize, DOMPurify cho HTML content. (4) NoSQL Injection: mongoose sanitize ({$ne: null} attack). (5) Rate limiting. (6) HTTPS: redirect HTTP→HTTPS. (7) Secure cookies: httpOnly, secure, sameSite. (8) Dependency: npm audit regularly. (9) Secrets: dotenv, không commit .env.

questions.question: Implement RESTful API với Express và best practices?

options.A: REST chỉ là convention, không cần follow
options.B: Resources, HTTP methods (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE), status codes, versioning (/api/v1), consistent response format, pagination, filtering
options.C: REST không cần HTTP methods khác nhau
options.D: Express không phù hợp cho REST APIs

questions.explanation: REST patterns: GET /api/v1/products (list), POST /api/v1/products (create), GET /api/v1/products/:id (get), PUT /api/v1/products/:id (replace), PATCH /api/v1/products/:id (partial update), DELETE /api/v1/products/:id (delete). Status codes: 200 OK, 201 Created, 204 No Content, 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found, 409 Conflict, 422 Unprocessable Entity, 500 Internal Server Error. Response: { data: [...], meta: { page, limit, total } }. Pagination: ?page=1&limit=10. Filtering: ?category=tech&price_min=100. Sorting: ?sort=price&order=desc.

questions.question: Implement file upload với Express và Multer?

options.B: Multer middleware xử lý multipart/form-data; validate file type/size; store on disk hoặc memory; upload to S3 với multer-s3
options.C: File upload cần third-party server

questions.explanation: Multer setup: const upload = multer({ storage: multer.diskStorage({ destination: './uploads', filename: (req, file, cb) => cb(null, Date.now() + path.extname(file.originalname)) }), fileFilter: (req, file, cb) => { if (!file.mimetype.startsWith('image/')) return cb(new Error('Images only!')); cb(null, true); }, limits: { fileSize: 5 * 1024 * 1024 } }). Dùng: router.post('/avatar', upload.single('avatar'), async (req, res) => { const file = req.file; ... }). S3 upload: multer-s3 với s3 storage config. Cleanup: delete temp file after process. Validate: check magic bytes (not just extension).

questions.question: Express WebSocket implementation với ws library?

options.B: Attach ws.Server đến HTTP server; handle 'connection', 'message', 'close' events; broadcast với room pattern; integrate với Express for REST + WS on same port
options.C: Cần separate server cho WebSockets

questions.explanation: Setup: const server = http.createServer(app); const wss = new WebSocket.Server({ server }); wss.on('connection', (ws, req) => { console.log('Client connected'); ws.on('message', (data) => { const msg = JSON.parse(data); broadcast(msg); }); ws.on('close', () => handleDisconnect(ws)); ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'welcome' })); }). Broadcast: const broadcast = (msg) => { wss.clients.forEach(client => { if (client.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) client.send(JSON.stringify(msg)); }); }. Rooms: Map<roomId, Set<ws>>. server.listen(3000) — Express và WS share same port.

questions.question: Implement Express app với TypeScript — setup và best practices?

options.B: @types/express cung cấp type definitions; extend Request interface cho custom properties (req.user); typed route handlers; strict tsconfig
options.C: Chỉ cần any type là đủ

questions.explanation: Setup: npm i typescript @types/node @types/express ts-node. tsconfig.json: strict:true, target:es2020. Extend Request: declare global { namespace Express { interface Request { user?: JWTPayload; } } }. Typed handler: const getUser: RequestHandler<{id:string}, UserResponse, never, UserQuery> = async (req, res) => { const { id } = req.params; res.json(await getUserById(id)); }. Custom error: interface AppError extends Error { status: number; }. Use zod for runtime type validation + TypeScript types. tsoa hoặc express-openapi-validator cho automatic OpenAPI schema.

questions.question: Express caching strategy — Redis cho API responses?

options.B: Redis cache middleware: check cache trước khi hit DB; set với TTL; invalidate khi data thay đổi; cache-aside pattern
options.C: HTTP Cache-Control headers là đủ
options.D: Caching tạo ra stale data không thể accept

questions.explanation: Cache middleware: const cacheMiddleware = (ttl = 60) => async (req, res, next) => { const key = `cache:${req.method}:${req.originalUrl}`; const cached = await redis.get(key); if (cached) return res.json(JSON.parse(cached)); res.sendResponse = res.json.bind(res); res.json = (body) => { redis.setex(key, ttl, JSON.stringify(body)); return res.sendResponse(body); }; next(); }. Dùng: router.get('/products', cacheMiddleware(300), getProducts). Invalidation: await redis.del('cache:GET:/api/products') khi create/update/delete. Pattern: cache-aside (check cache → miss → DB → cache → return). Cache headers: res.set('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=300').

questions.question: Express API documentation với Swagger/OpenAPI?

options.B: swagger-jsdoc để define schemas từ JSDoc comments + swagger-ui-express để serve UI; hoặc tsoa để generate từ TypeScript decorators
options.C: Swagger chỉ dùng cho enterprise

questions.explanation: swagger-jsdoc: const swaggerSpec = swaggerJsdoc({ definition: { openapi: '3.0.0', info: { title: 'API', version: '1.0.0' } }, apis: ['./routes/*.js'] }). JSDoc: /** @openapi "/api/users": { "get": { "tags": ["Users"], "responses": { "200": { "description": "List of users" } } } } */. Serve UI: app.use('/api-docs', swaggerUi.serve, swaggerUi.setup(swaggerSpec)). tsoa (TypeScript): @Route('/users') @Get('/') @Security('jwt') async getUsers(): Promise<User[]> {}. Auto-generate routes + OpenAPI spec. Postman import từ OpenAPI spec.

questions.question: Express app bị memory leak — cách diagnose?

options.A: Memory leaks không xảy ra trong Node.js
options.B: Node.js --inspect flag + Chrome DevTools heap snapshot; clinic.js; event listener leaks; closure giữ references; connection pool không properly closed
options.C: Chỉ cần restart server định kỳ

questions.explanation: Diagnose: (1) process.memoryUsage() log → xem heap increase overtime. (2) --inspect flag: node --inspect server.js → Chrome DevTools → Memory tab → heap snapshots so sánh. (3) clinic.js: npx clinic doctor -- node server.js → visual performance report. (4) Common leaks: EventEmitter maxListeners (setMaxListeners), unclosed DB connections, global arrays grow unbounded, request logger giữ req objects. (5) Leak simulator: wrk để load test → watch memory. Fix: removeAllListeners(), WeakMap cho caching, pagination cho queries.

questions.question: Express app bị slow response time — profiling approach?

options.B: Morgan logging thời gian, clinic.js flame, 0x profiler, identify: sync blocking operations, N+1 queries, missing indexes, missing caching
options.C: Chỉ cần nâng cấp server

questions.explanation: Profiling: (1) morgan response time: morgan(':method :url :response-time ms'). (2) clinic.js flame: npx clinic flame -- node server.js → identify CPU hotspots. (3) 0x profiler: CPU flamegraph. (4) Common issues: N+1 queries (SELECT users → loop SELECT posts FOR EACH USER → dùng JOIN hoặc batch). (5) Missing DB indexes. (6) Sync operations blocking event loop: crypto.randomBytes() sync → dùng async. JSON.parse/stringify large objects. (7) Missing cache → hits DB mỗi request. (8) Không compress: app.use(compression()) → gzip responses. (9) Missing keep-alive connections.

questions.question: Unhandled Promise Rejection crash trong Express — cách fix?

options.B: process.on('unhandledRejection') để log và graceful shutdown; wrap async handlers với try/catch; express-async-errors package; proper error middleware
options.C: Express 4 tự handle Promise rejections
options.D: Chỉ cần catch ở Promise chain cuối

questions.explanation: Express 4 không catch async errors automatically → uncaught rejection → crash. Fix: (1) Global handler: process.on('unhandledRejection', (reason, promise) => { logger.error('Unhandled Rejection', reason); process.exit(1); // let PM2 restart }). (2) express-async-errors: require('express-async-errors') — monkey-patch Express để wrap routes. (3) Manual try/catch trong mỗi async handler. (4) asyncWrapper: const wrap = fn => (req, res, next) => fn(req, res, next).catch(next). (5) Express 5 (beta): routes automatically wrapped. Combine với error middleware để return proper HTTP error.

questions.question: ECONNRESET errors trong Express API — nguyên nhân và fix?

options.A: ECONNRESET có nghĩa là server overloaded
options.B: Client đóng connection trước khi server gửi response; hoặc upstream service (DB, API) reset connection; cần graceful handling không crash
options.C: ECONNRESET chỉ xảy ra với HTTP/2

questions.explanation: ECONNRESET causes: (1) Client timeout — browser đóng connection khi response quá chậm. (2) Load balancer timeout — idle connection bị close. (3) DB connection reset khi idle quá lâu. Fix: (1) res.on('close', () => req.aborted logic) — detect client disconnect. (2) Không gửi response sau khi client disconnect: if (!res.headersSent && !res.writableEnded). (3) DB connection pool với keepAlive. (4) Keep-alive timeout setting. (5) Upstream errors: try/catch, fallback, retry. Log ECONNRESET riêng để không pollute error logs: if (err.code === 'ECONNRESET') return logger.warn(...).

questions.question: Express app trả về 'Cannot set headers after they are sent' error?

options.A: Lỗi chỉ xảy ra khi dùng TypeScript
options.B: Multiple response methods được gọi (res.json() + res.send(), hoặc next() sau res.json()); cần return sau khi gửi response
options.C: Lỗi do Express version không tương thích

questions.explanation: Cause: code path gọi res.json() (gửi response) rồi tiếp tục chạy và gọi lại res methods. Pattern sai: if (error) { res.status(400).json(error); } res.json(data); // vẫn chạy dù đã send! Fix: add return: if (error) { return res.status(400).json(error); }. Middleware pattern sai: middleware.js gọi next() sau res.json(). Check res.headersSent: if (!res.headersSent) { res.json(data); }. Async pattern sai: promise resolve gọi res.json(), nhưng timeout cũng gọi res.json(). Debug: console.trace() để tìm double-send location.

questions.question: Express app không scale với multiple cores — cách fix?

options.B: Node.js cluster module hoặc PM2 cluster mode để spawn workers per CPU core; shared state phải dùng Redis (không in-memory)
options.C: Cần rewrite sang Go để multi-core
options.D: Express tự scale với multiple cores

questions.explanation: Node.js cluster: const cluster = require('cluster'); const numCPUs = os.cpus().length; if (cluster.isPrimary) { for (let i = 0; i < numCPUs; i++) cluster.fork(); cluster.on('exit', (worker) => cluster.fork()); } else { require('./server'); }. PM2 (simpler): pm2 start server.js -i max (cluster mode). Shared state issues: (1) Session: phải dùng Redis store, không in-memory. (2) Rate limiting: Redis store, không local counter. (3) WebSocket: socket.io-adapter-redis để sync across workers. (4) File lock: không write same file từ multiple workers. Benefits: full CPU utilization, one worker crash không down app.

questions.question: Express API cần xử lý 10,000 concurrent requests. Architecture approach?

options.A: Express không thể handle 10k concurrent requests
options.B: PM2 cluster + Redis cache + connection pooling + load balancer + horizontal scaling + Nginx reverse proxy
options.C: Chỉ cần nâng cấp RAM server

questions.explanation: Scale architecture: (1) PM2 cluster mode: spawn N workers = CPU cores. (2) Nginx reverse proxy: load balance giữa PM2 instances, static file serving, SSL termination, gzip. (3) Redis: session store, cache, rate limit store. (4) Database: read replicas, connection pooling (PgBouncer). (5) Horizontal scaling: multiple app servers behind load balancer. (6) CDN: static assets. (7) Message queue (Bull/RabbitMQ): offload heavy tasks. (8) Circuit breaker (opossum): fail fast khi downstream service down. (9) Health check endpoint: /health → load balancer removes unhealthy instances. (10) Graceful shutdown: SIGTERM → stop accepting new requests → finish in-flight → exit.

questions.question: Express microservice với Docker và Kubernetes — setup?

options.B: Multi-stage Dockerfile, non-root user, health checks, graceful shutdown, Kubernetes Deployment/Service/Ingress, ConfigMap cho config
options.C: Chỉ cần Dockerfile là đủ
options.D: Kubernetes không cần thiết nếu có Docker

questions.explanation: Dockerfile: FROM node:20-alpine AS builder; WORKDIR /app; COPY package*.json ./; RUN npm ci --only=production; FROM node:20-alpine; RUN addgroup app && adduser -S -G app app; USER app; COPY --from=builder /app . EXPOSE 3000; HEALTHCHECK CMD wget -q http://localhost:3000/health || exit 1; CMD ["node", "server.js"]. Graceful: process.on('SIGTERM', async () => { await server.close(); await pool.end(); process.exit(0); }). K8s: Deployment (replicas:3, resources limits), Service (ClusterIP), HPA (autoscaling), Ingress (nginx), ConfigMap (env), Secret (DB password). Readiness/liveness probes → /health endpoint.

questions.question: Express API với GraphQL — Apollo Server integration?

options.A: GraphQL và REST không thể coexist
options.B: Apollo Server expressMiddleware() mount trên Express route; schema definition, resolvers, context (auth), DataLoader cho N+1, persisted queries
options.C: GraphQL thay thế Express hoàn toàn
options.D: Apollo Server không hỗ trợ Express 4

questions.explanation: Setup: const server = new ApolloServer({ typeDefs, resolvers }); await server.start(); app.use('/graphql', cors(), express.json(), expressMiddleware(server, { context: async ({ req }) => { const token = req.headers.authorization; const user = token ? verifyJWT(token) : null; return { user, dataSources: { userAPI: new UserAPI(pool) } }; } })). DataLoader: const userLoader = new DataLoader(async (ids) => { const users = await db.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ANY($1)', [ids]); return ids.map(id => users.find(u => u.id === id)); }). Batch loading → giải quyết N+1. Persisted queries: APQ để reduce request size. Schema stitching cho multiple services.

questions.question: Express app logging và monitoring cho production?

options.B: Pino/Winston structured JSON logging, correlation IDs, error tracking (Sentry), metrics (Prometheus), health checks, distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry)
options.C: Logging làm chậm ứng dụng đáng kể
options.D: Chỉ cần server logs là đủ

questions.explanation: Production logging stack: (1) Pino: fastest Node.js logger. const logger = pino({ level: process.env.LOG_LEVEL || 'info' }). Structured JSON: { level: 'info', time: 1234, reqId: 'uuid', msg: 'Request completed', duration: 45 }. (2) Correlation ID: middleware generate UUID per request → include trong all logs → trace request across services. (3) Sentry: Sentry.init() + Sentry.Handlers.requestHandler() + errorHandler(). (4) Prometheus: prom-client → /metrics endpoint → Grafana dashboard. (5) Health check: /health → { status: 'ok', db: 'connected', uptime: 12345 }. (6) OpenTelemetry: distributed tracing across microservices.

questions.question: Express API bảo mật cho financial application — checklist toàn diện?

options.B: HTTPS/TLS, JWT rotation, rate limiting, SQL injection prevention, input validation, audit logging, secrets management, dependency scanning, WAF
options.C: Chỉ cần authentication là đủ

questions.explanation: Financial API security: (1) TLS 1.3 minimum, HSTS. (2) JWT: short-lived (15min), refresh token rotation, revocation list in Redis. (3) Rate limiting: per endpoint, per user, per IP. (4) Input validation: Zod schemas, sanitization. (5) Parameterized queries: không interpolate variables. (6) Audit log: mọi sensitive operations (logins, transfers, admin actions) → immutable log. (7) Secrets: HashiCorp Vault hoặc AWS Secrets Manager — không .env trong production. (8) OWASP Top 10 checklist. (9) WAF (AWS WAF, Cloudflare) trước Express. (10) Penetration testing. (11) npm audit trong CI. (12) Subresource Integrity. (13) Feature flags cho gradual rollout.

questions.question: Migrate Express app từ CommonJS sang ES Modules — strategy?

options.A: Không thể migrate Express sang ESM
options.B: package.json 'type': 'module', .js → .mjs hoặc import/export, __dirname workaround (import.meta.url), dynamic imports cho conditional loading
options.C: Chỉ cần thêm import ở đầu file

questions.explanation: ESM migration: (1) package.json: { 'type': 'module' }. (2) Thay require/module.exports bằng import/export. (3) __dirname not available: import { fileURLToPath } from 'url'; const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url); const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename). (4) JSON import: import data from './data.json' assert { type: 'json' }. (5) Dynamic require: await import('./module.js'). (6) CJS packages: most npm packages dual support (CJS + ESM). (7) TypeScript: esModuleInterop: true, module: 'ESNext'. Benefits: native tree-shaking, top-level await, better static analysis. Incremental: 'type': 'module' + .cjs extension cho CommonJS files.
